lag_rule: ALAG1 only; dose times are NOT pre-lagged
lagged_f1_rule: CALLFL=-2 and $BIND DSEQ=DOSE retain the initiating dose tag at lagged delivery
history_rule: finite zero initial condition; each known dose once; no SS/ADDL
simultaneous_order: dose before observation; oral depot has no instantaneous central jump
DSEQ: 0=shared historical dose or observation; 1..N=chronological recent dose
